The '''Ast Kikorie system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] in the [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]] which was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" />
